# Native document parser fixtures

These are real PDF and OOXML files, generated by `reportlab`, `python-docx`,
`python-pptx` and `openpyxl`. All fixture text and the tiny TrueType font are
original test data dedicated to the public domain (CC0). No uploaded learner
document or proprietary installed font is included.

`embedded-cjk.pdf` contains an embedded valid TrueType font, compressed font
and page streams, Chinese ToUnicode mappings, a Form XObject and two pages.
Its font uses deliberately simple original geometric test glyphs; it tests
text decoding rather than visual rendering. `textless.pdf` contains vector
shapes and no text layer.

The Office files exercise Word headings/paragraphs/tables/header text,
PowerPoint slide text/notes and spreadsheet strings/numbers/formulas. The
test suite creates additional standards-shaped packages for relationships,
shared strings, sparse coordinates and hostile-container cases.

To regenerate, install the development-only libraries above plus `fonttools`,
then run `python generate.py` in this directory. Python and these libraries
are not runtime or installer dependencies. Parsing uses only compiled Go
code. Regenerated ZIP metadata may differ while fixture content remains the
same.
